hint_ladder: Add one thing that is not on the table right now, before you forget it.
Put the three words at the front of the sentence, then a dash or a comma and the new matter.
Start with the words: ___ — the parking permit expires on Monday.
teaching_content.reveal_form: Before I forget — the parking permit expires on Monday.
canonical_forms: Before I forget — the parking permit expires on Monday.
alternative_realizations: Before I forget, did you pay the invoice?
